lines.speaker: a
lines.text: Did you hear? The Hendersons' fence is two inches too tall.

lines.speaker: b
lines.text: Two and a quarter. I measured it twice.

lines.speaker: a
lines.text: Are you going to report them?

lines.speaker: b
lines.text: I already did. Twice. I'm just waiting for the drama.

lines.speaker: a
lines.text: I brought you a casserole. It's still warm.

lines.speaker: b
lines.text: I didn't ask for a casserole.

lines.speaker: a
lines.text: Nobody asks. That's what makes it a gift.

lines.speaker: b
lines.text: ...It smells good. I'm still mad, but it smells good.

lines.speaker: a
lines.text: New grill. Four burners, side smoker, cost more than my first car.

lines.speaker: b
lines.text: How much more? And did your wife know before or after?

lines.speaker: a
lines.text: She knows now.

lines.speaker: b
lines.text: Oh, she knows. The whole street knows. I told them.

lines.speaker: a
lines.text: Trash cans go back by 8 AM. It's 8:04. Four minutes late.

lines.speaker: b
lines.text: It's my trash can on my curb.

lines.speaker: a
lines.text: It's the neighborhood's curb, and the rulebook is very clear.

lines.speaker: b
lines.text: Write me up. I'll frame it and hang it in the garage.

lines.speaker: a
lines.text: Someone's moving in next door. I need to know everything before they unpack.

lines.speaker: b
lines.text: Why don't you just bake them a pie and ask?

lines.speaker: a
lines.text: Because then they'd know I want to know.

lines.speaker: b
lines.text: Honey, the whole street already knows you want to know.
